blocks.text: A subcloud is a subset of Public Service Edges for Internet & SaaS (ZIA), which are full-featured secure internet gateways that inspect all web traffic bidirectionally for malware, and enforce security, compliance, and next-generation firewall (NGFW) policies. Public Service Edges are deployed in Zscaler data centers around the globe, so when your users move to a different location, they can access the internet from any device and the Public Service Edges protect their traffic and apply your corporate policies.
Subclouds provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Ensure traffic from Zscaler Client Connector, PAC, or SD-WAN only connects to specific Zscaler data centers.
Allow Zscaler Client Connector and PAC file users to securely connect to regional surcharge data centers.
Redirect Zscaler Client Connector and PAC file users to the next closest data center.
Allow Zscaler Client Connector and PAC file users to securely connect to privately hosted data centers.

blocks.text: On the Subclouds page (Infrastructure > Internet & SaaS > Subclouds), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all the subclouds set up for your organization. For each subcloud, you can view the following information:
Name: The name of the subcloud.
Number of Data Centers: The number of data centers configured for the subcloud.
Number of Disabled Data Centers: The number of data centers currently removed from the subcloud data center list.
